clinical_intent: A patient demands to see their brachytherapy dose distribution and asks detailed questions about the treatment plan. The clinical team has not previously shared this level of detail with patients. How do you navigate the tension between patient autonomy and the complexity of explaining brachytherapy dose distributions to a non-medical person? What information should be shared, and how?
